runs.note: Events are scheduled at tick 112, the first tick after the 112-tick reset vector fetch (docs/core.md); an earlier tick is rejected as late.
Port 2 is GW_DEVICE_NONE, so no event can target it (the API returns UNSUPPORTED); port 1 keeps mask c1.

cases.citation: plutiedev controllers (three-button pad: with TH high the pins read 1,C,B,Right,Left,Down,Up, active low) and io-ports (data/control registers 0xA10003/0xA10005 and 0xA10009/0xA1000B); port 1 holds A|Start|Up (mask c1): only Up pulls a TH-high pin low

plutiedev controllers (three-button pad: with TH low the pins read 0,Start,A,0,0,Down,Up, active low; bits 3-2 read zero) and io-ports; port 1 holds A|Start|Up (mask c1): Start, A and Up read low, Down reads high

plutiedev controllers (three-button pad: with TH low the pins read 0,Start,A,0,0,Down,Up, active low; bits 3-2 read zero) and io-ports; port 2 holds B|C|Right (mask 38), independent of port 1: none of those buttons appears with TH low

plutiedev controllers (three-button pad: with TH high the pins read 1,C,B,Right,Left,Down,Up, active low) and io-ports (data/control registers 0xA10003/0xA10005 and 0xA10009/0xA1000B); port 2 holds B|C|Right (mask 38), independent of port 1: C, B and Right read low
plutiedev controllers: with TH low the Left/Right pins read zero on a connected three-button pad (ports 1 and 2)
plutiedev io-ports: with control bit 6 set, TH is an output driven from data bit 6; the ROM writes control 0x40 first, then data 0x40 (high) and 0x00 (low)

TH configured as an input (control 0x00) floats high through the pad pull-up, so the TH-high layout is read; Genesis Plus GX io controller handling consulted as a behavioural reference only; the plutiedev pages do not state this, so the case is REF-derived and not documented hardware evidence; port 1 holds A|Start|Up (mask c1)

TH configured as an input (control 0x00) reads the TH-high layout; Genesis Plus GX io controller handling consulted as a behavioural reference only; the plutiedev pages do not state this, so the case is REF-derived and not documented hardware evidence; port 2 holds B|C|Right (mask 38)

Assumption A6: plutiedev io-ports describes the 0xA10001 bit layout, but the value for the profile's console region and model has no independent fixture in this repository, so it is reported and not judged
plutiedev controllers and io-ports: port 1 TH protocol is independent of port 2; same expectations as port1-th-high and port1-th-low with port 2 unconnected (mask c1)

Assumption A7: an unconnected port reads all pins high (bits 5-0 = 1) in both TH phases; Genesis Plus GX io controller handling consulted as a behavioural reference only; the plutiedev pages do not state this, so the case is REF-derived and not documented hardware evidence

Assumption A7: an unconnected port with TH configured as input reads 0x7F; Genesis Plus GX io controller handling consulted as a behavioural reference only; the plutiedev pages do not state this, so the case is REF-derived and not documented hardware evidence
th.s control flow: the marker store is the last instruction before the idle loop, so it is reached only if every earlier port access completed without an unsupported stop
